sentiment.rationale: The company reported a GAAP loss driven by a one-time $794 million impairment charge, but Base Business EPS grew 4% in Q4 and 3% for the full year, with organic sales growth of 2.2% in Q4. Forward guidance for 2026 calls for organic sales growth of 1% to 4% and low to mid-single-digit Base Business EPS growth, which appears to be a continuation of current momentum rather than a material raise. The CEO's language is confident about long-term growth but acknowledges a 'difficult operating environment and slower category growth' in the short term, resulting in a mildly positive score.

summary.revenue: Full year net sales increased 1.4% to $20,382 million; Q4 net sales increased 5.8% to $5,230 million. Q4 organic sales grew 2.2%.
summary.eps: Full year GAAP EPS declined 25% to $2.63; Q4 GAAP EPS was $(0.05), down 106%. Full year Base Business EPS increased 3% to $3.69; Q4 Base Business EPS increased 4% to $0.95.
summary.guidance: For 2026: net sales expected up 2% to 6% including low-single-digit positive FX impact; organic sales growth expected 1% to 4%; GAAP basis expects gross profit margin expansion, advertising up, and double-digit EPS growth; Base Business basis expects gross profit margin expansion, advertising up, and low to mid-single-digit EPS growth.
summary.margin: Q4 GAAP gross profit margin decreased 10 bps to 60.2%; full year GAAP gross profit margin was 60.1% vs 60.5% prior year. Q4 Base Business operating profit margin was 21.2%, down 50 bps; full year Base Business operating profit margin was 21.3%, down 40 bps.
key_risks: Goodwill and intangible assets impairment charges of $794 million related to the skin health business (Filorga), driven by lower than expected category growth and weaker performance, particularly in China.
Difficult operating environment and slower category growth expected to continue in the short term.
Negative impact from lower private label pet volume (0.7% full year, 0.9% Q4).
Approximately 20 basis point impact on 2026 organic sales growth from exit of private label pet food business.
Tariffs announced and finalized as of January 28, 2026, included in guidance estimates.
key_opportunities: Net sales and organic sales grew in every category during Q4, led by oral care and pet nutrition (excluding private label).
Colgate's global market share leadership in toothpaste at 41.3% and manual toothbrushes at 32.4% year to date.
New 2030 strategy focused on accelerating growth through global reach, science-based innovation, omni-channel demand generation, and data/analytics/AI capabilities.
Record net cash provided by operations of $4,198 million for the full year.
Returned $2.9 billion to shareholders through dividends and share repurchases.

management_tone.label: confident
management_tone.justification: CEO Noel Wallace stated, 'we are operating from a position of strength and are confident that the changes we are making will enable us to deliver consistent, compounded earnings per share growth and drive shareholder value in the long term.'
